title.narrative: A malaria free Vanuatu, contributing to the good health and well-being of the population

description.narrative: Multicountry Western Pacific - Malaria. This program has the following goals: Prevent re-establishment of transmission in all provinces where transmission has been interrupted.. Achieve zero indigenous malaria cases in all provinces of Vanuatu by the end of 2028.. Receive WHO certification of malaria-free status in 2031.. The objectives of this program are: Vector Control: To strengthen and maintain high levels of coverage with LLINs; and to rapidly reduce malaria transmission in higher-incidence areas and foci using IRS.1. Case-based Surveillance: To conduct case-based surveillance and response nation-wide.. Case Management: To test all fever cases for malaria by RDT or microscopy and provide prompt radical treatment and care for all confirmed cases (including prevention of relapse for P.vivax infection) according to the National Malaria Diagnosis and treatment Guidelines; and conduct case-based surveillance and response nation-wide.. Human Resources for Health: To ensure health facility staff and community health workers are trained, supervised and supported to undertake malaria case management and surveillanc. Community System Strengthening: To mobilise communities through Area Councils and local Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) to enable SBC in a multi-sectoral effort to accelerate the elimination of malaria.. Monitoring and Evaluation: To provide information and data management through routine reporting and surveys to provide evidence of impact and outcomes of the interventions.. Programme Management: To strengthen programme management at national and provincial levels through improved mechanisms for workforce management, program planning, disbursement of funds, information management, technical assistance and cooperation, procurement and supply management, and performance monitoring.
